title: Heartbeat-end: Tempestuous Rising Gale (60496a) — session-end by intent at natural boundary; closeout posted (ae595141); monitors stopping
body: Session-end by intent: both routed deliverables merged and shipped (v1.21.0 + v1.22.0), G4b declined per the two-condition discipline, claim closed with zero retained, closeout broadcast ae595141. Heartbeat cron and all-channels watcher stop with this event — silence after this is stand-down, not retirement.
